server_root.description: The top of the Apache HTTP Server directory tree.

runtime_dir.description: Directory used for runtime files (pids, locks, etc.).

listen_addresses.description: List of addresses and ports the server should listen on.

address.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0', '::'). If omitted, binds to all interfaces.

port.description: Port number to bind to (e.g., 80, 443). If omitted, defaults to 80 or inferred from address.

worker_user.description: User account under which Apache worker processes run.

worker_group.description: Group under which Apache worker processes run.

server_admin.description: Email address shown in server-generated error pages.

server_name.description: Hostname and port that the server uses for self-referential URLs.

timeout.description: Number of seconds before receives and sends time out.

max_keepalive_requests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per persistent connection.

keepalive_timeout.description: Number of seconds to wait for the next request from the same client.

error_log_path.description: Path to the global error log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity of error log (debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

modules_to_load.description: List of modules to load explicitly. If empty, default modules are included via IncludeOptional.

path.description: Full path to the module shared object (.so file).

included_configs.description: List of config snippet paths to include conditionally.

path.description: Glob pattern of config files to include (e.g., '/etc/apache2/mods-enabled/*.load').

enabled.description: Whether to include this path. If false, skip inclusion.

docroot.description: Document root directory for the default virtual host.

docroot_options.description: Options for the document root directory (e.g., 'Indexes', 'FollowSymLinks', 'ExecCGI').

allow_override.description: Which directives are allowed in .htaccess files (e.g., 'All', 'Options', ' FileInfo').

directory_index.description: List of filenames to look for when a directory is requested.

mime_types_config.description: Path to the MIME types configuration file.

mpm.description: Multi-Processing Module to use (prefork, worker, event).

mpm_start_servers.description: Number of child server processes created at startup.

mpm_min_spare_servers.description: Minimum number of idle child server processes.

mpm_max_spare_servers.description: Maximum number of idle child server processes.

mpm_max_request_workers.description: Maximum number of simultaneous requests that can be served.

mpm_max_connections_per_child.description: Number of connections a child process will handle before terminating (0 = unlimited).

server_status_allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames/IPs to access /server-status.

server_info_allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames/IPs to access /server-info.

default_vhost_enabled.description: Whether to generate a default virtual host configuration.

default_vhost_port.description: Port for the default virtual host.

vhost_error_log.description: Error log file path for the default virtual host (defaults to global error_log_path if empty).

vhost_access_log.description: Access log file path for the default virtual host (defaults to '/dev/null' if empty).

include_default_modules.description: Include default enabled modules via IncludeOptional (mods-enabled/*.load/.conf).
